intro: Qatar has around 3 million people, but only about one in ten is a Qatari citizen.

chapters.title: Citizens and workers
text: Most residents are workers from South Asia, the Philippines, Egypt and elsewhere. Almost everyone lives in or near Doha.
Arabic is the official language and English is widely used.

chapters.title: Life
text: Islam is the state religion. Qatari citizens receive free education, health care and other benefits.

keyTerms.meaning: A system that tied migrant workers to their employers; Qatar reformed it.
